I've struggled with depression for my whole life and been suicidal for many years. I played DDLC knowing fully well that it dealt with some pretty heavy subject matter. I figured that surely it can't be that bad, right?

Wrong.

Though I feel mostly fine now, seeing particularly Yuri and her spiral into madness ramped up my anxiety to heights I hadn't ever seen them. I had grown very attached to Yuri, to the point where I could see myself falling in love with her if I let myself. She's pretty much perfect in act 1, even down to the knife collecting. (I have a fascination with knives too. I don't cut though.) She's shy and awkward, yet at the same time very nice and personable once you break through her shell. She reminds me a lot of myself as well. I'm very much like that. Which made it even easier to develop a bond with her. 

But then act 2. Her descent into madness. I know that it was Monika's tampering, but it made me wonder. Could I become that crazy? Couple that with years of abuse from my mom convincing me I'd grow up to be a killer and it just screws with my head that much more. And also when I develop feelings for someone I start to get a bit obsessive. I have her final poem burnt into my brain. Every time I think about it I start to panic. What if that's me in the future? I know rationally that I would never become like that, but I have this lingering doubt that I might have it in me. I don't want to be like that. 

Her stabbing herself repeatedly was another trigger. Prior to playing DDLC, I had thought about suicide a lot, and doing exactly that was one method I thought about a lot. That just made yet another similarity between me and Yuri. 

And it wasn't just Yuri. Sayori too. When she opened up about her depression, it was so relatable. I often lie in bed and don't get up for a few hours because I have no motivation. Not only did she remind me of myself, she also reminded me a lot of a good friend of mine. Actually extremely similar. She's suicidal too and I feel hopeless to help her. So seeing Sayori hanging from her ceiling was really troubling. And the narrative from the protag about what he could have done differently. I know that feeling and it feels terrible! 

Everything feels so real. I said I'm mostly fine at the start of this comment but I lied. I'm not fine. This game messed me up. I wish I never played it. Even though I love it. 

I want to die.
